title: the Cape Route Rising
premise: In the winter of 1888, Dominic Iversen keeps the Cape Route light and a quiet grief for his late wife, raising his late brother's daughter, Marta, among the fishermen who have become his unlikely family. A sealed letter, carried ashore by a drowned courier, names the Iversen family as guarantors of a smuggling ring run by the harbor magistrate — and demands the workshop's ledgers as proof of silence. As great storms batter the coast and the river ice threatens to break early, Dominic must decode his father's hidden accounts, protect Marta from the magistrate's men, and choose between exposing the plot and preserving the found family that depends on him. He finishes the work in the burning workshop's final hours, testifies before the ice breaks, and loses the lighthouse but gains a family bound by truth rather than blood.
about_author: Jude Iversen is the pen name of a former maritime archivist who spent a decade cataloguing lighthouse keepers' logs along the North Atlantic coast. The Cape Route Rising is their second novel, drawn from a family legend about a ledger that never burned.

chapters.title: The Light Before the Letter
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Establishes the lighthouse routine, his grief for Elena, and his bond with Marta and the fishing families. A storm season begins early. Emotional beat: quiet endurance masking loneliness.

chapters.title: A Courier Who Never Left
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. A body washes up below the light clutching a sealed letter addressed to 'Iversen.' Dominic hesitates to open it. Emotional beat: dread arriving disguised as duty.

chapters.title: What the Seal Demands
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. The letter names the family in a smuggling conspiracy and demands the workshop ledgers by spring thaw. Dominic burns nothing and tells no one — yet. Emotional beat: fear hardening into resolve.

chapters.title: Marta Counts the Boats
chapters.summary: Marta's POV. Sharp-eyed Marta notices unfamiliar ships anchoring at odd tides and asks questions adults deflect. Emotional beat: a child's clarity cutting through adult evasion.

chapters.title: The Workshop Below the Cliff
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. He reopens his father's sealed workshop and finds false drawers in the ledger cabinets. Emotional beat: inheritance revealed as burden rather than gift.

chapters.title: Old Halvorsen's Warning
chapters.summary: Halvorsen's POV. The aging fisherman recognizes the magistrate's pattern from decades past and urges Dominic to burn everything and say nothing. Emotional beat: survival wisdom versus conscience.

chapters.title: First Frost, First Threat
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. The magistrate's clerk visits with polite menace, asking after 'family papers.' Marta hides in the stairwell and hears everything. Emotional beat: the noose tightening gently.

chapters.title: The Ledger in Two Hands
chapters.summary: Marta's POV. Marta helps Dominic decipher coded entries; her talent for numbers cracks the cipher's rhythm. Emotional beat: found family deepening through shared labor.

chapters.title: Storm One: The Sea Takes a Name
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. The first great storm wrecks a boat; among the dead is a man who once worked for Dominic's father. Emotional beat: grief layered on grief, history repeating.

chapters.title: An Offer Written in Ink
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. The magistrate offers protection and money if Dominic surrenders only half the ledgers — enough to hang others, not himself. Emotional beat: temptation dressed as mercy.

chapters.title: The Night Marta Ran
chapters.summary: Marta's POV. Frightened by the clerk's return visit, Marta flees to Halvorsen's hut; Dominic finds her there and confesses everything. Emotional beat: secrets dissolving into trust.

chapters.title: What Elena Knew
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Among Elena's letters Dominic discovers she had found one ledger page before she died — and chose silence to protect him. Emotional beat: memory reframed; the dead were braver than he knew.

chapters.title: The Fishermen Vote
chapters.summary: Halvorsen's POV. The harbor families meet secretly; some want payment, most want the magistrate gone. They pledge to stand with Dominic if he stands first. Emotional beat: found family becoming a deliberate covenant.

chapters.title: Storm Two: The River Rises
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. The second great storm floods the low road and cracks the river ice early; the workshop begins taking water. Emotional beat: nature as countdown clock.

chapters.title: A Theft in the Dark
chapters.summary: Marta's POV. The clerk breaks into the workshop; Marta, keeping watch, triggers the alarm and saves the true ledger but is injured. Emotional beat: courage with a cost.

chapters.title: Half Truths Before a Justice
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Dominic gives a partial deposition in town, testing whether the courts can be trusted — they cannot; the magistrate sits with the panel. Emotional beat: institutions failing, resolve clarifying.

chapters.title: The Cipher's Last Page
chapters.summary: Marta's POV. Marta completes the decoding: the final entries name the magistrate outright and clear the Iversen name. Emotional beat: vindication arriving too quietly to feel safe.

chapters.title: Storm Three: Fire on the Water
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. During the worst storm, the magistrate's men fire the workshop to destroy evidence; Dominic carries the ledgers out through smoke and collapsing beams. Emotional beat: climax — losing the past to save the truth.

chapters.title: Testimony Before the Thaw
chapters.summary: Halvorsen's POV. With the ice groaning apart, the fishermen escort Dominic to the provincial assizes; the full ledger is read aloud over the magistrate's objections. Emotional beat: collective voice breaking solitary power.

chapters.title: The Ice Breaks
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. The magistrate is arrested; the river ice shatters and releases the winter. Dominic watches from the ruined light tower, unburdened but hollowed. Emotional beat: release shadowed by loss.

chapters.title: What Remains Standing
chapters.summary: Marta's POV. Spring rebuilding: the community raises a new keeper's cottage together; Marta formally asks to be called an Iversen. Emotional beat: found family choosing its own name.

chapters.title: The Light Kept Lit
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Epilogue: Dominic lights the lamp each night still, teaching Marta the trade, the ledgers archived in the town hall. Emotional beat: memory honored, power answered with steadiness.
